modules.title: 同一条生成时间线，三种等待感从哪里来
首段等待、生成速度和总时长怎样区分

items.title: 先等 TTFT
items.text: TTFT 是从点击发送到收到第一个 Token（文字片段）的时间。

items.title: 再看 TPS
items.text: TPS 是第一个片段之后每秒生成多少 Token；这里不是每秒交易数。

items.title: 最后看总时长
items.text: 回答越长，即使开头很快，也可能需要更久才完整结束。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: TTFT 很短不代表完整回答很快；长回答还受生成速度和长度影响。

lessonPractice.title: 模型 A 一秒出现首字但长回答生成很慢，模型 B 三秒开始却很快写完。应该怎样比较速度？

options.label: 分别记录首段等待、生成后速度和完整回答总时长
options.feedback: TTFT、TPS 和总时长描述不同阶段，分开测才能解释两种体验差异。

options.label: 只比较谁先出现第一个字，并据此认定整体速度更快
options.feedback: 首段等待短不代表后续生成快，长回答的总完成时间可能反而更久。

options.label: 把网络等待和生成速度合成一个 TPS 数字，不区分阶段
options.feedback: TPS 描述开始输出后的生成速率，混入前置等待会失去指标含义。

en.title: Model A shows its first token in one second but generates slowly; Model B starts in three seconds and finishes quickly. How should speed be compared?

options.label: Measure time to first content, generation rate after start, and total completion separately
options.feedback: TTFT, TPS, and total time describe different phases and together explain the two experiences.

options.label: Compare only which model shows the first character and call it faster overall
options.feedback: Short first-content wait does not imply fast generation, and a long answer may finish later.

options.label: Combine network waiting and generation into one TPS number without phases
options.feedback: TPS describes output rate after generation starts, so including prior waiting removes its meaning.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请分别测量请求到首段的 TTFT、开始输出后的 TPS 和完整回答总时长，使用相同模型参数与回答目标。不要用“秒回”代替完整比较，并把网络、排队和生成阶段分开记录。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Measure TTFT, TPS after output begins, and total completion separately under the same model settings and answer target. Do not replace full comparison with feels instant, and record network, queue, and generation phases.

learning.assumes: You have experienced a chat answer that waits, then appears in pieces.
learning.outcome: You can read a timeline and separate TTFT, TPS, and total duration.

modules.title: Where do three kinds of wait come from on one timeline?
Separate first output, speed, and total time

items.title: Wait for TTFT
items.text: TTFT runs from send to the first text token.

items.title: Then watch TPS
items.text: TPS is tokens per second after generation begins, not transactions per second.

items.title: Then measure total time
items.text: A longer answer can still take longer to finish even when it begins quickly.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A short TTFT does not mean a fast full response; generation speed and output length still matter.
